text:
Noah (People Ops): Quick announcement: three small policy updates rolling out today. 1) International travel pre-approval window shortened to 10 business days for routine trips; high-risk locations still require 15 days. 2) Were adding 2 "wellness flex" days per year (manager-approved, confidential). 3) Compassionate leave now has an optional +3 day top-up for qualifying incidents. Full details + request forms: https://intranet.redwood/people/updates-may2026. Please review if you travel or anticipate PTO around major launches. :loudspeaker:

Priya (Finance): Expense process update  corporate card charges will auto-attach receipts via TravelBot for bookings through the Travel Portal. Personal card expenses still need manual upload within 30 days to avoid flags. If you see missing receipts, ping finance.

Sam (People Ops): Clarification: the wellness flex days are separate from PTO and do not roll over. Use them for mental health or short rest days; no documentation required. Managers can approve quickly in the HR modal.

Ava (Eng): I have a family trip May 13-15 that was approved in March. Does this change anything?

Noah (People Ops): If your PTO was manager-approved before today, its grandfathered. DM me the approval or cc your manager and well mark it as exception.

TravelBot: Travel portal: uploads for visa docs added. Commands: `/travel status` `/travel upload <id>` `/travel help`  see intranet travel page.

Priya (Finance): One note on the compassionate top-up: payments processed as reimbursements when applicable. Stipend requests without receipts will be reviewed case-by-case. Expect standard reimbursement timing (~2 pay cycles).

Noah (People Ops): We'll host 20-min office hours tomorrow 9:30 PT to walk through examples and exceptions. Please bring approvals if you need grandfathering. We'll pin the policy doc after the session. :pushpin:
